title: Return a result
summary: PL/SQL: Return a result. Call twice(7). Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A local function gives reusable steps a name and returns a typed value.

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Return a result

blocks.text: The local function returns n times 2. Input 4 produces 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A function must return a value on its successful path.
